open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity (full name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation) that contracts with Tavus, Inc. — is it Cerebrium Inc. (Delaware)? Please also provide your principal place of business (251 Little Falls Drive, Wilmington DE appears to be a registered-agent address), and clarify why your Terms of Service designate United Kingdom governing law.

As a US company offering services to EU data subjects (Stockholm region, GDPR claims): have you designated an EU representative under Article 27 GDPR? If yes, please provide the representative's name and full address; if no, please state the basis on which Article 27 does not apply to you.

Please confirm that no data protection officer has been appointed and that support@cerebrium.ai is the authoritative contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests (SAP requires a named channel).

Is your current SOC 2 attestation Type I or Type II, what is the report period, and can you provide the report under NDA (your security page says Type I; other pages indicate Type II as of July 2026)? Please also provide your ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement — your blog says 'ISO 27001 compliant'; is this a certification by an accredited body or a self-assessment?
What minimum TLS version is enforced for data in transit to your API and inference endpoints (TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3)?
Your security page states all user data is encrypted at rest — with which algorithm and key length (e.g. AES-256)?
Are backups (including the daily database backups referenced on your security page) encrypted, and with which algorithm?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest (platform-managed KMS, customer-specific keys, CMEK/BYOK options)?

Can Cerebrium, acting as a processor, anonymize or pseudonymize personal data (including video/audio frames processed during inference) on the customer's instruction, or does this rest entirely with the customer?

Do you have a signed DPA with Tavus that flows down GDPR Art. 28 obligations, and can you provide your current sub-processor list (your HIPAA materials reference vetted subcontractors under BAAs — SAP will ask for the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the underlying cloud provider(s) hosting your GPU regions)?

For inference workloads: is customer media (video/audio frames) persisted at any point (queuing, caching, logging, persistent storage), and if so where and for how long — or is it processed in memory only?
